messages:
rachel: Quick report from aurora-48k-int3 onboarding. Running the longprefill benchmark (30k tokens) and seeing repeated fragments from ~5k tokens earlier appear mid-generation. Looks like RoPE scaling changed between prefill and live decode. Minimal trace below. Anyone seen RoPE policy flip during autoscaling?

peter: which roperescale policy and kv window settings? Command?

rachel: repro command:
```bash
./bin/bringup --model aurora-48k-int3 \n  --run longprefill --prompt tests/long/30k.txt \n  --quant int3 --rope_policy adaptive --kv-window 48k --kv-autoshrink on
```
log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-25T09:03:11Z] prefill: rope_scale=1.0021, write shard=7 seq_base=4800 len=2048 fp=0xdeadbeef
[2026-03-25T09:03:12Z] kv: autoshrink triggered -> new_window=40960 reason=mem_pressure
[2026-03-25T09:03:12Z] prefill: write complete shard=7 next_seq=6848
[2026-03-25T09:03:13Z] decode: rope_scale=0.9989, reading shard=7 seq=4800 fp=0xdeadbeee
[2026-03-25T09:03:13Z] token_dup: token[12987]==token[9897] (unexpected)
```

tony: fp off-by-one and rope_scale mismatch. Two independent bugs could cause this: autoshrink rebase bug that mutates seq_base semantics, and adaptive rope policy recomputing scale at decode time instead of snapshotting.

rachel: quick dump shows shard metadata changed after autoshrink:
```
shard7_before: {seq_base:4800, fp:deadbeef, rope_scale:1.0021}
shard7_after:  {seq_base: -512, fp:deadbeee, rope_scale:0.9989}
```

peter: Negative seq_base again. We should have an invariant: seq_base >= 0. If autoshrink uses a different origin, we need normalization during both write and read. Also rope_scale must be recorded into shard metadata at write time.

rachel: reproducible locally; switching to kv-autoshrink=off removes the issue. int3 seems more sensitive than int4/q4_0. int8 no repro.

tony: mitigation plan: 1) disable autoshrink for onboard canaries by default; 2) add an assert on seq_base >=0 in kv writer; 3) snapshot rope_scale into the shard header at prefill and prefer header value on replay. I'll draft patches.

peter: add a small regression test: prefill with adaptive rope -> force autoshrink -> replay and assert fingerprint equality and rope_scale equality. Mark INT3-ROPE-SNAPSHOT-19876 as P0 for onboarding.

ci-bot: CI job queued: CI/longprefill#19876 (staging). Will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

rachel: thanks. Leaving the staging canary for 8h with autoshrink disabled and telemetry on. Will post soak results. :coffee:
